gbm_population_evidence.quote: At least one evaluable lesion, with previous biopsy or histopathological confirmation of high-grade glioma (WHO grade 3-4), and after comprehensive treatment, imaging examination indicates continued progression or recurrence;

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Allogeneic B7-H3 CAR-γδT Cell Therapy Recurrent/Progressive High Grade Glioma（R/R HGG）

role_evidence.quote: aimed at evaluating the safety and efficacy of allogeneic B7-H3 CAR γδT in patients with malignant glioma

agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic B7-H3-directed CAR gamma-delta T-cell therapy (QH104)

source_quote.quote: The pathological tissues removed by surgery can be used for immunohistochemical detection of target proteins (paraffin sections should be within half a year), and the expression of B7-H3 is positive;

coder_notes: Only intervention is an allogeneic CAR-gamma-delta T-cell therapy -> excluded_intervention_type; no pharmacological candidate. B7-H3 positivity is an entry requirement and matches the CAR target, but the CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. CSF CAR copy number (PK) and CSF cytokines (PD) are planned for the cell therapy, not for a drug candidate, so tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned coded no. GBM named in conditions with WHO grade 3-4 HGG eligible -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named.
